routes._comment: Racemic (untagged) IR profile so a plain Methylphenidate oral dose wins a sane curve at priority 1 instead of falling through to drug.community's impossible onset-after-peak row (onset 120 > peak 60). The isomer-D curated rows are dexmethylphenidate's (2× potency) and don't match a racemic dose. Doses match the community consensus for racemic IR MPH; they must be present because a route with no `doses` still emits an (empty) dose row that would otherwise classify every dose as sub-threshold.

routes.notes: Transdermal patch (Daytrana). A delivery route of methylphenidate, not a separate compound. Tiers are the FDA-approved patch strengths (10/15/20/30 mg, titrated over ~9 h wear), not a recreational ladder. Deliberately no duration: patch kinetics are a prolonged-delivery system the curve does not model, so a transdermal dose marks its time rather than drawing a curve (unmodeled-release-form policy).
